text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening stance and preview of three reasons","quality":"organizing thesis","description":"It states a position early and lays out the main reasons that will structure the essay."},{"evidence":"“My first point… My second point… My third and final point…”","quality":"logical organization","description":"It uses explicit signposting to make the argument easy to follow from paragraph to paragraph."},{"evidence":"“Imagine driving down the road and your car just suddenly malfunctions”","quality":"concrete reasoning","description":"It develops claims by imagining specific consequences rather than relying mostly on broad assertions."},{"evidence":"expensive prototypes, repair costs, insurance","quality":"supporting detail","description":"It provides more detailed support for its claims, especially on cost, instead of speaking in generalities."},{"evidence":"“As a 16 year old, I have just gotten my permit”","quality":"personal connection","description":"It includes a relevant personal experience that makes the argument feel more grounded and immediate."},{"evidence":"“takes away something that every human should eventually know”","quality":"value-based appeal","description":"It frames the issue as a matter of an important human skill and responsibility, not just convenience."}]}
